articles.summary: Cambridge, Mass. – December 21, 2023 – Biobot Analytics, a global leader in wastewater epidemiology, announced that the company has reached full enrollment for a nationwide program sponsored by the National Institute on Drug Abuse (NIDA) to conduct anonymous, population-level wastewater-based monitoring on drugs of use and misuse, and overdose reversal agents. articles.title: Biobot Analytics Reaches Full Enrollment for NIDA-funded Nationwide Wastewater-Based Monitoring Program for High Risk Substances
